input.question: Who is the creator of the "Iconoclast"?

documents.text: Iconoclast (EP) ICONoclast is the debut release for Clinton Sparks. It was released on the 9 September through Def Jam, Photo Finish Records. This EP is the first solo material released by Clinton Sparks, for being behind the scenes producing and song-writing for other artists for so many years Clinton decided to go it alone after Kanye West and Beyoncé saying that he should and also having so many other artist deals from different labels. The EP is a genre defying music embodiment of Clinton's influences ranging from Queen, Weezer, Prince all the way to De la Soul, Teddy Riley
